scope: We found 152 proteins in total tooth protein extract.

For the isolation of protein from different teeth, a protocol standardized by Sharma et al. was followed. Briefly, 10 g of the powder was taken and mixed with 20 mL of demineralization solution containing 0.1 M EDTA, 100 mM NaCl, and protease inhibitors (Roche) at 20 °C for 2 days, centrifuged at 10,000 rpm, and collected supernatant was dialyzed against HEPES buffer, pH 7.4.
We have isolated protein extracts from four major types of human teeth i.e. Molar,Premolar,Incisor and Canine through deminralization process.
